content: I can’t determine the most likely next items from only “item 426” without transaction or co-purchase data. If you provide the grocery purchase dataset or item association rules, I can compute the top 10 item IDs.
prompt:

A customer has bought item 426. Which 10 items are they most likely to buy next, in order of likelihood?
Answer with 10 integer item IDs, most likely first, separated by commas or one per line. No explanation.
